newsitem.title: INDIA: India CRISIL gives BAFL CP P1+ rating.
newsitem.headline: India CRISIL gives BAFL CP P1+ rating.

text.p: India's Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Friday that the 100 million rupees commercial paper programme of BAFL has been rated P1+ indicating that the degree of safety with regard to the timely payment of the instrument is very strong.

BAFL was promoted by Bajaj Auto Limited (BAL) and a few of its dealers in 1987 with the primary objective of financing two wheelers manufactured by Bajaj Auto Limited (BAL), the largest two wheeler manufacturer in the country.

Financing of two wheelers of Bajaj Auto Limited (BAL) through hire purchase continues to be the main business of BAFL, which alongwith leasing business accounted for over 80 prcent of its total income for 1996/97. BAFL is also engaged in other funds based activities such as bills.

Though the company operates in a segment where payment defaults tend to be high, the company has over the past ten years of operations has proven itself in successfully reducing and controlling debtor levels, CRISIL said.
